=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3352-3361, 4068-4109 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The "Integration post-sync test repair" step and the conflict-resolver step now run a full `review_untrusted_sandbox.sh prepare codex` (via `review_prepush_test_gate_integration_main` and `_resolver_prepush_test_gate`), but neither step sets `DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS`. The broker therefore falls back to `DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS` (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:160; scripts/dependency_registry_proxy.py:18 / 28-48).
  WHY: Consumers that set `vars.DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS` get a gate venv without their dependencies, because the install failure is only a warning (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:273-275). Suites then fail on both head and baseline and are classed `inherited` (or unverified), so the repair turn never runs. All reviewers rated it MAJOR. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash filed it under SECURITY; the others filed it under CORRECTNESS. Suggested fix: add `DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS: ${{ vars.DEPENDENCY_PROXY_ALLOWED_HOSTS || '' }}` to both env blocks.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_prepush_test_gate.sh:407 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Captured test output is injected directly into the repair prompt, so output containing `=== END CAPTURED TEST FAILURES (UNTRUSTED) ===` could escape the untrusted block.
  WHY: An attacker could inject instructions into the editor turn and widen the repair scope. Source severity is MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash explicitly refuted this, citing the per-line `sed 's/^/UNTRUSTED_DATA: /'` prefix.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:24653 | severity=high | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_dispatch_integration_test_repair` does a non-atomic read-modify-write of STATE_FILE using jq.
  WHY: Concurrent pollers could lose updates to `integration_test_repair_dispatches`, exceed the INTEGRATION_CONFLICT_LIFETIME_MAX cap and flood integration heads with repair dispatches. Source severity is MAJOR. minimax_minimax-m3 and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 explicitly declined to report this (atomic tmp+mv pattern; outside the last run's changes).
- tests/test_implement_prepush_test_gate.py:test_timeout_above_the_step_budget_is_clamped | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: When stderr has no `timeout_clamped=<n>` line, the test accepts any `--timeout-minutes` value from 1 to 53 instead of asserting exactly 53.
  WHY: This removes the regression check on the 53-minute static clamp; a fallback to 15 would still pass. Source severity is NIT. Fix: `else: assert int(match.group(1)) == 53`.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1019 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The outer `timeout --kill-after=30s 600` around the resolver's full `prepare codex` is shorter than the inner 900 s deps-container budget (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:185). SIGKILL at 630 s bypasses the EXIT trap (scripts/review_untrusted_sandbox.sh:77).
  WHY: On a slow or cold runner, where the image build is unbounded (`_review_sandbox_build_image 0`, line 122), the kill leaks the `review-deps-$$` container (3 GB, 2 CPUs) and the `review-isolated-*` root. The integration path uses a 1200 s outer bound and is not affected. Both reviewers rated it NIT (confidence 3 and 2).
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:908 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `sandbox_prepare_ephemeral` (via `_resolver_sandbox_attempt`) is bounded to 600 s, but if the wrapper SIGKILLs the process before its EXIT trap runs, sandbox cleanup does not occur.
  WHY: Failed or slow builds could leak sandbox containers and roots on the orchestrator runner, leading to resource exhaustion. Source severity is NIT.
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1045 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The hardcoded 600 s timeout for prepare-ephemeral inside the 9000 s step budget does not check whether enough budget remains before starting.
  WHY: Timeouts might kill sandbox preparation, wasting runner time and producing confusing module_absent/timeout outcomes without running the gate. Source severity is NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and minimax_minimax-m3 state the budget is checked (`gate_wall + 630` reserve).
- scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:1060 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_resolver_test_repair_context` fails closed (returns 2) when no V2 or V1 state is found in tracking-issue comments.
  WHY: Early-stage projects without orchestrator state skip integration test repair, so regressions stay unrepaired. Source severity is NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 states failing closed is intended.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml:3344 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The Integration post-sync test repair step runs on integration heads using configuration variables (e.g. PREPUSH_TEST_GATE_MODE) from vars/env.
  WHY: A compromised or insecurely configured variable source would create a new trust boundary for configuration injection. Source severity is NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash state these values are allow-list or regex validated.
- scripts/heal_isolated_implement.sh:292 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The heal gate runs without `--venv`, in the clarify sandbox image (only `python3 python3-yaml`, scripts/clarify_sandbox/Dockerfile:6-7). Every pytest suite is classed `unverified`/`pytest_unavailable`, so the heal repair turn can never fire.
  WHY: A heal run that breaks a pytest suite is transferred unchanged, which contradicts the changelog.d/8201 claim. Source severity is NIT. Suggested fix: qualify changelog.d/8201 and agents.d/8201 to say the heal gate covers non-pytest checks only.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- tests/test_implement_prepush_test_gate.py:test_timeout_above_the_step_budget_is_clamped | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Without a `timeout_clamped=<n>` line, the test accepts any value from 1 to 53 instead of exactly 53.
  WHY: This removes the regression check on the 53-minute clamp; production is not affected. Fix: `else: assert int(match.group(1)) == 53`.
- (hardening suggestion) scripts/review_conflict_resolve.sh:`_resolver_prepush_test_gate`, just before the `prepare-ephemeral` fallback
  PROBLEM: When the full `prepare codex` fails, the resolver falls back to an image-only gate without logging anything, unlike the integration path.
  WHY: Suggested fix: emit `echo "PREPUSH_TEST_GATE phase=resolver outcome=warning reason=prepare_failed fallback=image_only" >&2`.
- Ruled out from pass 1: prompt-injection breakout (per-line `UNTRUSTED_DATA:` prefix), jq read-modify-write of STATE_FILE and V2/V1 fail-closed (out of scope, intended), resolver prepare budget (checked), 600 s vs 900 s container leak (not evidenced), `vars` trust boundary (allow-list or regex validated).
